title: apartment garden?
content: For some reason I keep dreaming about a small apartment complex, probably like 8-12 units, with a balcony courtyard thing that connects all of the upper level ones. The apartments are not super nice, pretty run down actually. And there’s a vegetable garden in the courtyard. I spend a lot of time here, sometimes there are other people sitting in the garden reading and smoking. It’s like a weird calm spot in the mall world which is usually chaotic. Anyone else been here?
